lineage.note: The 1986 supplement prints "DENISE HARLING (Francis Fujan Harling, Frank Fujan, Philomena Kastl Fujan, Peter)", but the same entry calls her a "daughter of Frances Fujan and Donald Harling", and her mother is printed Frances in every other place (s023 child list, s071 heading and text). Kept as printed.

The 1986 supplement prints "ROSE MARIE FUJAN (Marvin Fujan, Frank Fujan, Philomena Kastl Fujan, Peter)", but the same entry calls her a "daughter of Frank Fujan and Emma Stirch", and the 1985 list (s023) has her as Frank's child 3, born 1935, while Marvin was born 1930. She is placed as Frank's daughter; the printed lineage is kept as printed.

count.heading: The family of Mary Frances Cuda and Robert A. Harrison
count.note: This "Page 20 Correction and Addition" entry reprints only child 1, Frank Thomas, with his new birth and marriage details. The 1985 list (s022) numbers three children (Frank Thomas, Michael Andrew, Robert Joseph), and the supplement gives separate family entries for the other two, so the family keeps all three.
